en.headline: Woman rescued after paraglider catches in tree at Ma On Shan
en.dek: A 38-year-old foreign woman was freed uninjured after her paraglider became snagged in a tree about 10 metres high near Ngong Ping on Saturday afternoon; the Government Flying Service assisted.
body: A woman was rescued uninjured on Saturday after her paraglider became caught in a tree while she was flying near Ngong Ping in Ma On Shan.
Police received a report at about 4.30pm that a 38-year-old foreign woman had been left hanging after her paraglider snagged in a tree roughly 10 metres high. Companions raised the alarm.
Firefighters and rescue personnel assembled at Tai Shui Tseng in Sai Kung and climbed to the site. The Government Flying Service also deployed a helicopter with rescuers and equipment.
The woman was located, freed and brought to safety. She remained conscious and uninjured and did not require hospital treatment, later making her own way down the hill.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山昂平滑翔傘女子被困樹上 消防救出無恙
zh.dek: 一名38歲外籍女子周六下午在馬鞍山昂平玩滑翔傘時被困約10米高大樹，消防及飛行服務隊到場救出，事主無受傷。
body: 一名女子周六在馬鞍山昂平玩滑翔傘期間意外被困樹上，其後獲救，無受傷。
警方下午約4時半接報，指一名38歲外籍女子在昂平玩滑翔傘時，疑因風勢影響，滑翔傘卡在一棵約10米高的大樹上，同行人士報警求助。
消防人員由西貢大水井上山搜救，政府飛行服務隊亦派出直升機協助運送救援人員及物資。
救援人員成功將女子救出至安全位置。事主清醒，並無受傷，毋須送院，其後自行落山。
